name: Data Pipeline Engineering
description: Designs, builds, and operates the ingestion, transformation, and quality-assurance pipelines that move and shape data reliably — the discipline generic software-construction doesn't cover.

checklists.name: Data Pipeline Engineering Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist before a data pipeline is trusted by downstream consumers.

items.statement: The Data Pipeline Specification documents every source, transformation, and destination the pipeline touches.
The Data Quality Report covers completeness, accuracy, and freshness checks, not just that the pipeline ran without erroring.
Failure and retry behaviour is defined for every stage, so a partial failure doesn't silently produce incomplete data.

reviewGates.name: Data Pipeline Quality Review
reviewGates.statement: The Data Quality Report has been reviewed and the pipeline is accepted as trustworthy for downstream use.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the data-quality evidence justify letting downstream consumers rely on this pipeline's output?

obligationDefinitions.title: A data-quality anomaly flagged by pipeline QA checks must be triaged, not silently passed through
obligationDefinitions.description: A pipeline's own quality-assurance checks (schema drift, null-rate spikes, referential breaks) exist to catch bad data before it propagates downstream; a flagged anomaly must be triaged and dispositioned, not allowed to flow through on a default-pass configuration.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every data-quality anomaly flagged by pipeline QA checks is triaged within the declared SLA.

requiredEvidence.title: Data quality anomaly triage record
requiredEvidence.description: Record of anomaly triage disposition and timing.
